standings.finding: 29 of 32 teams are cell-for-cell identical across 512 compared cells. 3 teams moved across 25 cells (PIT, NYG, WAS). Columns that moved: conf, conf_pct, div, div_pct, home, l, last5, net_pts, pa, pct, pf, road, streak, w. The only result known to have landed between the two reads is the Thursday 12 November game, Commanders 24 - Giants 21, which NFL.com's scores page shows as Final. NFL.com does not state why any standings value changed, so every moved cell is listed here rather than explained away.

team_stats.finding: 30 of 32 teams are cell-for-cell identical across 576 compared official cells. 2 teams moved across 28 cells (WAS, NYG). Columns that moved: att, cmp, cmp_pct, first_downs, first_pct, int, longest, pass_td, pass_yds, passes_20plus, passes_40plus, rating, sack_yards, sacks, yds_per_att.
